title: Mako's shape: one bank, two cards paid in full on the 10th and 11th, pay on the 10th
story: One main bank. Two cards paid in full from the bank: card A closes on the 15th and is paid on the 10th of the next month, card B closes at month end and is paid on the 11th of the next month (close days made up). Two incomes land on the 10th. Bills come out of the bank on due days. A trip goal is kept in the bank, set aside, and grows by 20,000 each pay day. Set up on Fri 20 Nov 2026, after the November pay and the November card payments went through. January 2027: the 10th is a Sunday so pay lands Fri the 8th; the 11th is Coming of Age Day so both cards are taken Tue the 12th. February: the side pay is two days late. Every amount is made up.
